adversarial_cross_turn_fixture.scenario: An alternative is introduced in one user-assistant pair and receives its attached condition in the next pair.
adversarial_cross_turn_fixture.v1_result: blocked because the alternative alias is read-only prior context in the second window
adversarial_cross_turn_fixture.product_relevance: Real ambiguous conversations often qualify an option one turn after introducing it.

decision.required_revision: Allow prior-context aliases only in alternative_evidence_ids when the focal pair supplies the new attached condition or limit; keep attached-condition evidence focal-only.

nonclaim: Passing the five existing protected fixtures does not establish multi-turn relationship coverage.
